$comment: The feedback buttons under every message Lyra's workers send (v0.137.0). One contract, read by the workers (workers/stock_scanner/feedback.py builds the first keyboard) and by the web app (src/lib/feedback/telegram-feedback.ts answers the taps), so the two can never disagree about what a button says or what its data means. callback_data is `<prefix>:<generation id>:<step>[:<pillar code>]`, at most 45 bytes (Telegram allows 64). The pillars are the six the nightly review scores (workers/stock_scanner/content_judge.py), so a reader's reason lands on the same radar as the judge's score.
note_reply: Thanks - noted. Your reply goes to the person who builds Lyra.
